units: <cite ref="Mishnah Chagigah 1:2">Ḥag. I, 2</cite>. Y. ib. 76ᵃ bot. <he>חֲגִיגָתוֹ</he> his festal sacrifice; a. fr.—Pl. <he>חֲגִיגוֹת</he>.
